name: microsoft-office-addin
description: Connect Codex to open Excel, Word, and PowerPoint task panes through Office.js.

interface.shortDescription: Read and edit open Office documents through Office.js.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to task panes loaded in Microsoft Office. Discover connected documents and run JavaScript in a specifically selected document's Office.js context. Scripts can read and write the document and have the task pane's normal JavaScript capabilities.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Microsoft Office to inspect or edit my open Office documents.
